items.source: Returns the methods of the given bean class.
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 类的方法。

items.source: This class scans a list of objects for methods annotated with McpSampling and creates Function callbacks for them. These callbacks can be used to handle sampling requests from MCP servers in a reactive way.
items.translation: 该类会扫描对象列表，查找带有 McpSampling 注解的方法，并为其创建 Function 回调。这些回调可用于以响应式方式处理来自 MCP 服务器的采样请求。

items.source: samplingObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpSampling
items.translation: samplingObjects - 包含带有 McpSampling 注解的方法的对象。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no sampling methods are found or if multiple sampling methods are found
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未找到任何采样方法，或者找到了多个采样方法时

items.source: the methods of the bean class

items.translation: 异步采样回调的提供者。

items.source:
// Create a provider with a list of objects containing @McpSampling methods
AsyncMcpSamplingProvider provider = new AsyncMcpSamplingProvider(List.of(samplingHandler));

// Get the sampling handler
Function<CreateMessageRequest, Mono<CreateMessageResult>> samplingHandler = provider.getSamplingHandler();

// Add the handler to the client features
McpClientFeatures.Async clientFeatures = new McpClientFeatures.Async(
    clientInfo, clientCapabilities, roots,
    toolsChangeConsumers, resourcesChangeConsumers, promptsChangeConsumers,
    loggingConsumers, samplingHandler);
items.translation:
// 创建一个包含 @McpSampling 方法的对象列表的提供者
AsyncMcpSamplingProvider provider = new AsyncMcpSamplingProvider(List.of(samplingHandler));

// 获取采样处理器
Function<CreateMessageRequest, Mono<CreateMessageResult>> samplingHandler = provider.getSamplingHandler();

// 将处理器添加到客户端功能中
McpClientFeatures.Async clientFeatures = new McpClientFeatures.Async(
    clientInfo, clientCapabilities, roots,
    toolsChangeConsumers, resourcesChangeConsumers, promptsChangeConsumers,
    loggingConsumers, samplingHandler);
